fields.label: Options
fields.description: Comma-separated dropdown values (e.g. Aesthetic, Technical). Leave blank to render this category as mandatory free text at capture time.

fields.label: Default Value
fields.description: Should match one of the Options entered on this row, if any are set.

fields.label: Mandatory
fields.description: Only applies when Options are set. If Options is empty, this category is always mandatory free text.
